title: Elizondo was NRO liaison while at TTSA

tellings.quote: Whilst he was at TTSA, uh Luellaando was liaison to the NRO.

plain: Around 2017, while the former Pentagon official Luis Elizondo was working at To The Stars Academy, a private company that studied UFOs, he was also serving as a liaison to the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. This comes from a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, who points to Elizondo's own CV as the source. If so, it would mean Elizondo kept an active tie to the intelligence world while working in the private UFO effort.
